dressing.py: OSM trees tagged taxon=Arecaceae / taxon:en=Palm should become 'palm' (St Anne fan palms 2919578844 (821.6, 461.5), 2919578872, 2919578882, 2919580140; R:18, R:23, R:25); OSM bollards outside the Jaffa bbox are skipped (2953456085, 5904662071 at the Lions' Gate inner face are ~0.45 m stone cubes, R:06: needs a stone-cube bollard prop).

Paving: Lions' Gate Street is OSM surface=sett (ways 290986904, 744664057, 744664059, 26492728) and every photo shows rough grey-cream setts with smooth slab kerb strips (R:12, R:09, R:13, R:18), not the slab paving used now.

Atlas: a pale mint / pale blue louvred shutter cell (~RGB 0.66, 0.80, 0.78) for the French buildings of St Anne (gatehouse w288395720 R:26, east range w288395735 R:25, seminary); shutter_green / shutter_blue are dark.
Facade feature: a frieze of small blind round arches under the cornice (w288395734 upper floor, R:18) and a pierced parapet with small round-headed openings (St Anne gatehouse/courtyard, R:22).

Terrain / ground: (a) the raised terrace (OSM pedestrian area 1544948036) on the south side of the seminary plaza, ~1.5 m above the street with a broad stair of long steps along the street (2 steps at x ~793, ~10 risers further east; R:12, R:18); (b) the Group Meeting Point stage 744670112 raised ~2 m with a 15-step stair 1395044677 (OSM only); (c) the Pool of Bethesda excavation 126864878 is 5-8 m deep with steel stairs and railings (R:28, R:29): a SUNKEN region (~dz -6) for its polygon.

Gates (landmarks_gates): Herod's Gate tower m_herods_gate is 15.2 m; the notes measure the wall top at ~12 m and the total at 12.5-13 m (R:43 at 79 px/m, confirmed in the review: policemen 1.84 m, wall top 11.8-12.7 m). In render hg_out the tower reads much taller than R:44. The passage also looks straight through to a building inside; R:34-R:36 show the vaulted chamber and a low exit arch (~2.2 x 2.8 m) just east of centre in the south face.

Walkability (spec owner): (a) the Via Dolorosa 44830379 is tagged layer=-1 in OSM and infill.py (line 74) skips layer<0 ways as corridors, so infill fills the street: f118/f119/f126 on the s09 side at x 558-630 and one in this sector at x 668-681 (this profile keeps x 560-681 open with an open area; the rest, x 494-560, still needs the fix). (b) The St Anne entrance passage 288395740 (building_passage, layer -1, (843, 471)->(844, 462)) through the gatehouse w288395720 is blocked, so the whole St Anne / Bethesda domain is unreachable; it is a 1.4 x 2.9 m pointed passage (R:26). Adding it to covered_streets would carve 4.4 m and split the gatehouse facade, so it is requested as a 1.6 m passage instead. (c) building=roof layer=1 footprints over open footways block them (w1392508822 over Aqabat Darwish, removed here; w1393163048 over Ash Sheikh Rihan 26492740, which OSM tags layer=-2 and infill f66 covers for 18 m: verify whether that lane is a tunnel). They should become vaulted passages.

Domes: an explicit settings 'domes': 0 is read as 'not set', so the vernacular dome field still goes on roofs the photos show flat: w290986909 (roof terraces with railings, chairs and black water tanks in R:20; 4-5 domes in render lg_top). Please let an explicit 0 switch the field off; this pass would then set it on w290986909, w290986927 and w1393176152 (R:18 / R:20 flat roof terraces).

Muazzamiyya passage 744664059 (x 688-715): it is ~4.5-5 m wide with a pointed east arch ~4.5 m wide and ~5.5 m to the apex (R:14, R:15, notes 2.11); the spec uses the default passage half-width 1.6 m (3.2 m). Its floor is a ramp of setts with a steel handrail (R:13, ~10-13 %), but stairs.py turns it into treads (render muazz r2). Same for King Faisal 123254013 (ramped, R:13).

Props: a French tricolour flagpole on the south-west of St Anne (~(832, 510), R:24, R:27) (the flagpole prop carries an Israeli flag); the free-standing ancient column (~2.5 m on a 0.9 m square base) in the corner at the arch's north-east pier (~(789.5, 453.5), R:17, R:18).
